summary: Official warnings for the drug IWILFIN note myelosuppression, which is a decrease in blood cell production, so blood counts must be checked before and during treatment [3]. The warnings also highlight hepatotoxicity, which is liver damage, requiring liver function tests before and during treatment [3]. Depending on the severity of these issues, the drug may need to be paused, lowered in dose, or stopped permanently [3]. Additionally, results from a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug a low liver score of 13 and a low heart score of 23 [M].
